premises: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in the as-cast state has minimal short-range order (SRO).
Lack of SRO creates a uniform potential landscape that facilitates dislocation glide, leading to low hardness/strength and high plasticity.
Inducing SRO via annealing creates local compositional barriers that pin dislocations.
Dislocation pinning by SRO increases hardness and compressive strength.
